caption:
Most follow-up sequences die before the first message goes out.

Owners know follow-up matters. What kills it is time: writing five to seven touches across text and email, in the right order, at the right intervals, takes longer than most owners have this week.

A sequence that works looks like this:

Text within 5 minutes of the lead coming in
Email same day with more detail
Second text at day 3 if no reply
Final touch at day 7 before the lead goes cold

The AI Follow-Up Builder on the Black Arrow tools page writes that sequence for you. Answer a few questions about your business and get the texts and emails ready to use.
